definition: Globalization is the increasing worldwide spread and connection of technologies, products, and ways of living across societies. In this context, it is described as improving access to medical technology while also helping spread unhealthy lifestyles, such as greater processed food consumption and more sedentary behavior, which can raise the burden of non-communicable diseases.
